book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Mz Lr Galesia Provins

content: Bzkq Lxngitiamu Leplz Kcng Tzsuti Drtwrdr Kx Namnclzbzmu Mz Lou Mz Nzrlapxngr
Kraes arlapxle nigu murde drtqgu naopx. X trsutiu drtwrde nzmnclz-mou-krbzmu mz Lou sc Mosis. A' natu-amqngiamu mz nzarlapxkr Kraes nimu.
Murde ninge, Pol, pibo bamu kx nzmu nimu kxtrngiulrJiu rlr-lzbq-ngrbzmu mz nzrpakrngr nzrlapxngr nimu, e nzbzkr Kraes mz kros trpnzngr nzarlapx-krde nimu.
Aclvetio-angidramu! Murde ncblo kx natubqbz mz nzobqkr Gct mz nzrlr-lzbq-ngrbz mz nzrpakrngr, navz-nqblq-kzle Lou sc Mosis amrlx x bzkq tao mz alwx.
Kxnzvz-nqblqlr Lou mz nzatubqtingr nidr nzpxtxpxpe-ngrdr zmrlz ngr Gct kxmyalz. X sc tzlakitxpxpebzng mz nqvi lr Kraes.
A' mz nzokatrkr Mqngrkxtr, sc tqobqtipxku da amrlx kx esalz-ngrbz Gct bagu mz nzatubqtikr Kraes nigu kcng tzbrtipe drtwrgu nide.
Murde mz nzaxvctr-krbzku mz Mevalu Jiszs, trpnzngr da kx ablepxle nzmu napakrgu o trtingr. A' da kx myapxbz ngi nzrlxngitingr nide, x nzrvz-nqblqngr nide mz nzmrlzti-krgu leplz.
lr Galesia vz-nqblq-angidramu Kraes mzli kc. ?Neke aesakibzle nzvz-nqblq-krmu lrpzki angidr ngr nzarlapxngr?
Nzrtamitingr la, trvzpxpuu mz Gct kc tqaveatile nimu mz nzngini-krmu doa nedeng.
Nzalvztrngr kxtrka kxpipzne krlzle nzatrkati-krde nzrlxngitikr leplz ne Gct amrlx, da kc tqwai yisti kxpipzne nztalvzpx-krde flawa kx nangi bret, mz nzawzpx-krdele.

A' lxngitix kx Kxetu rgu sa naokatrle nimu murde navz-nqblqamu Nrpakxmrlz kc tqalvztrpo bamu mzli kc. A' Gct sa na-ayrplapxle mrlx kc tqakamrbr-ngrbzle drtwrmu, mz nzalvztrngr lc tqtrka, kxmule-esz' nide neke.

?Mzlengeng x inwengeng, nzmu sa tqalvztrpex kx ncblo napakr, nike drtwrdr tqngya-ngrmle bange? Nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzalvztr-krnge kx nzbzkr Kraes mz kros txpwz kx arlapxle nigu, murde rblx nzglqpx-lzbq-krdr mz da lc.
A' sutitx zlwz drtwrnge kx krkcng tzatrkatilr nimu mz rtulrtr-ngrbzlr bamu nzrpakrngr, navzpx-lzbq-kzng.
Navz-nqblqku Nzycmne-krm Mqngrkxtr Mz Nabzgu
Mzlengeng x inwengeng, Gct aopxle drtqmu murde naokatramu kztemung mz nivz. A' mz nzprtr-krmu mz nzaopxkr drtqmu lc, bzkq vz-nqblqamu nepunr drtwrmu kx ataole nimu mz alwx kc tq atrkatile leplz.
Murde sa tqangidapeamu Lou kc atwrnrngr mz nzvz-nqblq-krmu natq kc tqrpile kx, “Mrlzti kztemqng da kc tqwaiq nzmrlzti-lzbq-krm.”
A' bzkq atrkatiamu nzmnctr-lxblrkr leplz ne Gct, mz nzngya-etrkr drtwrmu x nzotablr-etr-krnamu.
A' vz-nqblqamu nzycmnekr Mqngrkxtr mz nabzmu, murde mz nzale-krmu da lc, trnavz-nqblqwamuu nepunr drtwr lcng tqtrka.
Nepunr drtwrmu x Mqngrkxtr nzota-etrng x nzota-ebirtr-zvzpxmqng bamu, mz nzaprcti-krdr nimu.
A' vz-nqblqamu Mqngrkxtr, murde mz nzale-krmu da lc, trmnclzpepwzmuu mz Lou sc Mosis.
Nepunr drtwrdr kxdrka'ngr mailzle leplz mz nzale-krdr da kxnzmulr lcde seng. Nzrmwimingr leplz kx trngiu krnalzdr, trnzlqngi-kru drtwrdr, nzamqmiti-rbr-krdr mz nrkrdrtqdr,
nzangio-krdr da kx trngiu Gct angidr, nzryzplengz-krdr leplz, drtwrdr kxmwa, trnzmnc-nivzlr-krdru, nzdobukr drtwrdr, nzyrpupxkr zngya, nztalwz-krdr, nzrpwa'-zvz-krdr da, nzaki-lzbq-krdr,

nzrkcmnz-krdr, nzrmnq-zvz-krdr, x trnzclu-krdru mz da kx myangr drtq. x da kxnzmulr lcng. Kabo bamu natq kx xplr mzli ka, da kc tqwaile mzli kc, kx leplz kx nzale-zvzng da lcng trnatwzlru da kcng nzvzpxmqng mz Gct, murde nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzngini-krde King rdr.

A' nra Mqngrkxtr mz nabz leplz kcng tzvz-nqblqlr nide, nidr seleng: nivz, nzelalz-krm drtwr, nzmnczpwxngr, nzaenzli-zpwxngr, nzokatrngr, nzrmrlzngr, nzatukztrngr natq, nzvz-nrwxngr, x nzaclve-lzbqngr. X Lou sc Mosis tr-rpwa'-ngrdeu nzale-krmu da lcng.
A' doa neng Mevalu Jiszs nzrtxo-amqngilr nepunr nabzdr kxdrka'ngr. X opxm kx nztqlvztrlrng mz kros.
X namnc-nqblq-zvzku natq Mqngrkxtr mz nabzgu, murde nide kc tqalu-mople nigu.
A' bzkq glqpx-lzbqku, murde batr-ngrbzku nzngyatikr drtwr leplz nigu x nzdobuti-krdr nigu.
